Three of the four vendors in the register have a signed DPA. Hollowpine does not.

**Signed:**
- **Cobaltline, Inc.** (VEN-014): signed April 2, 2025 [1]
- **Parcelwise Ltd.** (VEN-022): signed November 20, 2023, amended September 2025 for EU standard contractual clauses [3]
- **Saltmarsh Analytics GmbH** (VEN-027): signed June 12, 2025 [4]

**Not signed:**
- **Hollowpine Software Co.** (VEN-031): the DPA is not signed. The draft arrived in July 2026, and redlines with legal have been open since August. The main open point is Hollowpine's right to use ticket content to train its reply-suggestion model [2]. Hollowpine is running under security exception SEC-EX-117, approved August 24, 2026 [2]. The security review is a conditional pass, which requires AI reply suggestions to stay disabled until the DPA is signed [2]. If the DPA is still unsigned when the exception lapses, Support Operations must either renew the exception or move ticket intake back to email [2].

The three big bets picked at the cycle 5 pitch review on September 8, 2026 were Tributary, Lantern and Hydrant. The handbook allows at most three per cycle, and seven pitches came in [1][2].

- **Tributary:** streaming joins (the Enrich step), pitched by Mateo and LZ. Its GA target is January 2027 [1]. It has been in private beta since October 1 [4][5].
- **Lantern:** a self-serve billing portal, pitched by NH and HV. The original plan was beta in December and GA in January 2027 [1]. That has since moved. The October leadership notes say GA slips to March 2027 and beta moves to February [5], and the codename register agrees [4].
- **Hydrant:** automatic scaling of ingest gateways per cell, pitched by OA. It shipped to all production cells on October 22, 2026 [3][4].

Not every pitch was picked. Tidepool (Postgres CDC v2) was not picked in cycle 5 and needs a re-pitch with smaller scope [4].

Three of the four INC-2291 action items are confirmed shipped. The fourth is marked done in the postmortem, but I couldn't confirm it from a later source.

- **Certificate chain validation in the rotation job** (platform team, due Aug 28): marked done [2].
- **Canary alert for sustained handshake failures** (ingest team): marked done [2].
- **Shorter gateway TLS session ticket lifetime**, from 4 hours to 30 minutes (ingest team, due Sep 15): shipped ahead of schedule. The September changelog lists it as shipped [4].
- **"TLS handshake errors" dashboard panel** (observability): marked done [2].

The postmortem's status marks are dated August 14, the same day as the incident, so they may not reflect later progress. The Q3 board update says "all action items are on track," but it doesn't say which are complete [3].

A related change also shipped in October: canary bake time went from 20 to 45 minutes, and promotion now requires zero sustained TLS handshake errors between gateways and brokers. The deploy note cites INC-2291 as the reason, but it isn't one of the four listed action items [6].

Five production services are classed as Restricted [1]:

- **Conduit** (owner DP): source and destination connectors. Stores encrypted connector credentials and sync cursors [1].
- **Driftwood** (owner PLAT): long-term object archive behind the hot buffer. Stores archived event payloads, partitioned by workspace and day [1].
- **ingest-gateway** (owner DP): accepts events from customer SDKs and the HTTP API. Stores in-flight event payloads only, with nothing persisted beyond the Kafka hot buffer [1].
- **Keystone** (owner IDB): authentication and authorization. Stores hashed API keys, SSO/SAML configuration, and session tokens [1].
- **runner** (owner DP): executes customer pipelines. Stores partition state in local RocksDB and reference-table snapshots [1].

Four items are Tier 3 and not stocked in any clinic. Each must be ordered from the wholesaler for a named patient, which takes about 5 business days [1]:

- **Td** (0.5 mL prefilled syringe), self-pay $46. Tdap is preferred; Td is given only on request [1].
- **HPV vaccine, 9-valent** (0.5 mL prefilled syringe), self-pay $295. Ages 9–45 [1].
- **Meningococcal B vaccine** (0.5 mL prefilled syringe), self-pay $190. Ages 16–23 or on specialist advice [1].
- **Pneumococcal conjugate, PCV21** (0.5 mL prefilled syringe), self-pay $280. Only when the clinician specifies PCV21 [1].

Named-patient orders go to the clinical pharmacist [1].

Tier 2 items (Hepatitis B, recombinant zoster, ceftriaxone) are not in every clinic. They are stocked only at hub clinics, and other clinics request a transfer from the nearest hub, which arrives within 2 business days [1]. The hub clinics are Riverside, Northgate and Harbor Point [2].

Under the current standard, four clinics count as large: Harbor Point, Northgate, Riverside and Elm Park. The standard defines large as over 80 average in-person visits per day, effective September 1, 2026 [2].

| Clinic | Code | Avg visits/day (Q3 2026) |
|---|---|---|
| Harbor Point | HBP | 118 [3] |
| Northgate | NGT | 102 [3] |
| Riverside | RVS | 94 [3] |
| Elm Park | ELP | 85 [3] |

The other five clinics are medium or small. Northbridge (52), Riverbend (46) and Elmhurst (38) fall in the 40–80 range or below, and Cedar Hollow (31) is small [3]. Note that Elmhurst at 38 is under 40, so it is small, not medium.

Bands are reset every quarter from the directory's visit averages, so these placements may change [2][3]. The 2025 standard set the large threshold at over 90, which would have excluded Elm Park [1]. That standard was replaced on September 1, 2026 [2].

Five vendors list 24-hour support in the vendor support matrix, so they cover P1 problems around the clock [1]:

- **Bayline Reference Laboratories** (HL7 results feed into Switchyard): P1 response 30 [1]
- **ClearPath Software** (ClearPath PM): P1 response 30 [1]
- **Coriander Media** (video SDK and hosted media servers): P1 response 20 [1]
- **Meridian Clinical Systems** (Meridian EHR): P1 response 15 [1]
- **Polyglen Interpreting** (interpreter operations desk): P1 response 10 [1]

The other three have shorter coverage. Larkspur Telehealth and RotaLeaf are 7 and 8 hours, and Quillon Ambient is 6 hours [1]. The matrix doesn't state the unit for the P1 response figures, so check the source table before quoting them as minutes or hours.
